comment: Took Prof Grace at UR and has by far been my favorite journalism class. He assigns material that is actually interesting and fun for students, and his projects are genuinely enjoyable. Super funny and interesting guy to listen to!

JOUR203 is a relatively easy class taught by an incredible, experienced journalist. Professor Grace is always energetic and ready to teach. The format of the class allows for less lectures and more engaging discussions. Be prepared to spend time outside of class working on projects and assignments (especially the interview project.)

Great class and professor. Professor Grace is one of the best professors I have had in the journalism department. The class is pretty easy. Mostly just discussion posts on movies or podcasts and then 3 partner projects. Heavy discussion based class on movie watched but professor leads them well and does not cold call.

Hilarious, gave thorough feedback, and excellent at class time management. Assignments can be time consuming, but he is always willing to guide you through them. He knows a great deal about documentaries and podcasting, learned a lot about them throughout the course.
